id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description: The name of the assetImportance importanceLevel.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

importanceLevel.description:
Importance level for the specific asset.
importanceLevel must be unique and can hold anywhere from 1 to n with 1 being most critical.

translationMap.description: Translated description for the assetImportance importanceLevel.

displayName.description: Translated name for the assetImportance importanceLevel.

title:
Type to represent the importance level of an asset.
This type is used to categorize assets based on their criticality or importance
in the {@link ReliabilityAsset} hierarchy.
name: ReliabilityAssetImportance
